description: Search dblp authors by name from a stored copy of the publisher's CC0 bulk release. Returns the dblp person id, name variants, affiliations, ORCID when listed, and publication count; the most-published people come first, which separates the famous namesake from the rest. Every answer carries data_as_of, answered_from and the licence.
